title: Managing Oneself
scope: Publisher reprint main prose PDF pp. 3–12. Intro summary, pull quotes, author note, running furniture, reprint notice and further reading excluded. Inline speaker quotation counted as main prose. Headings excluded from prose; printed inline questions are retained as part of paragraphs.
method: Read all source-ordered body text, viewed page renderings, joined paragraphs across columns/pages, normalized Unicode NFKC, joined wrapped words, collapsed whitespace and corrected observed short-term/long-term hyphenation. The normalized text is an exploratory reconstruction, not a transcription certified at character level. Function tags are a single coder judgment.
